scope: Original local MISTBOUND finite deckbuilding sample; no original commercial-game content

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production original game environment bitmap for MISTBOUND, a mature illustrated maritime deckbuilding voyage. WIDE panoramic landscape, landscape aspect. Cinematic hand-painted gouache and finely etched storybook realism, elegant dark petrol blue / sea-glass turquoise / desaturated pale stone / restrained warm amber. A vast fogbound sea passage at blue hour, rocky sea stacks and a distant isolated lighthouse near the far right. Small golden beacon on lighthouse, moody soft wind and delicate sea foam. The central lower 60 percent is mostly dark continuous open seawater providing calm readable negative space for independently composited ships. Horizon at upper 30 percent. Lower edge gently dark. Attractive premium indiegame art, painterly depth and textured atmosphere; no cute/cartoon children art, no characters, no ships, no written text, no letters, no numbers, no UI or card borders, no watermarks. This is scenery only, playable ship silhouettes and all cards are separate runtime UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original premium mature maritime fantasy game card illustration atlas, exactly 2 columns by 3 rows, six equal edge-to-edge rectangular cells, with no gaps or dividers. Every illustration is centered within its own cell and fully separated, no subject spills between cells. Same exquisite gouache and etched engraving style, soft maritime petrol navy / verdigris sea-green / pale stone / brass amber, dramatic composed lighting. Upper LEFT: a bronze naval cannon on wooden deck, powder smoke and amber spark. Upper RIGHT: a brass storm lantern hung by rope, protective sea-green light around it. Middle LEFT: folded sea chart, ivory compass and brass navigation dividers on blue cloth. Middle RIGHT: ship repair tools, coil of hemp rope, timber plank and iron nails lit by soft lamp. Lower LEFT: a large weathered metal anchor and taut rope sinking into teal water. Lower RIGHT: three aligned bronze ship cannons firing a coordinated golden salvo across fog. Each cell has an elegant detailed painterly focal subject and atmospheric dark blue background, broadly same scale and consistent art. No card frames, no decorative borders, no title banners, no labels, no written text, no numbers, no logos, no people, no copyrighted game assets. Six illustrations only. Portrait atlas aspect, total proportions roughly width2 height3. Intended to be sampled as native HTML card artworks in a playable deckbuilder.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent original game sprite atlas, precisely 2 columns by 2 rows equal cells with ample margin, four separate complete isolated maritime objects, one per cell, generous padding, no overlapping. Premium mature hand-painted gouache + fine etched illustration style, petrol navy teal and ivory / copper amber, elegant readable silhouettes, detailed but clean, no childish art. Consistent side-on 3/4 view low camera, not top-down. Upper LEFT: sturdy modest exploration sailship facing right, ivory sails, teak dark hull and one small amber lantern, 2 masts. Upper RIGHT: larger threatening raider sailship facing left, dark charcoal sails, sharp prow, rusty brass cannon ports, 2 masts. Lower LEFT: a twisting turbulent spectral storm mass above sea surface, teal-black wind vortex surrounding a pale amber eye, visually not a human, isolated cloud/water swirl. Lower RIGHT: tall narrow ivory lighthouse tower on compact rock foundation, amber beacon at top, no surrounding landscape. All fully visible and cleanly cut out against actual transparent background, NO floor backdrop, NO sky or rectangular panels, NO text, no labels, no borders, no watermark. The four objects are intended to be rendered as independent sprites over open seawater in a maritime cardbattle game.
